name: Lead (Astra)
notes: Room Lead. Owns technical decisions, dispatches Peers, accepts or rejects candidates. One Lead per project.

name: Advisor (Sol 6.1)
notes: Room Advisor on Codex gpt-6.1-sol. Second opinion and reviewer for the Lead; reads only, decides nothing. Created only by the Lead.

name: Lead (Opus)
notes: Room Lead on Claude Opus 5.5: the Lead Human works with, from grilling through build and acceptance. Consults the Sol Advisor. One Lead per project.

name: Peer
notes: Room Peer. Owns exactly one bounded outcome from the Lead (writable, or a read-only review). Created only by the Lead.

name: Peer (REA)
notes: Room Peer with REA reverse-engineering tools (binaries, Electron/JS, .NET, websites). Created only by the Lead, only for reverse-engineering work.

name: Peer (MiniMax)
notes: Default room Peer on OpenCode + MiniMax M3.1 Flash. Leads use it for all Peer work; Kiro (room-peer) only when Human asks for it, or for REA.
